## 🤖 Real Breaking-Change Summary

# Breaking Changes from v2.7.18 to v4.1.1

- **Spring Boot Gradle plugin no longer auto-configures gRPC** when the Protobuf plugin is applied. You must now explicitly configure gRPC by adding an empty `grpc` block to the `protobuf` extension if you want `protoc-gen-grpc-java` to be automatically configured. (#50822)

That is the only documented breaking change. The remainder of the release notes describe bug fixes and documentation improvements with no API or configuration changes that would break existing applications.

🚨 **No reviewer could be assigned** — this repo has no `CODEOWNERS` entry matching the changed file, and no `DEFAULT_REVIEWERS`/`DEFAULT_TEAM_REVIEWERS` fallback is configured. Assign a reviewer manually before merging.

- [ ] Endpoint-by-endpoint Postman validation through every gateway this service sits behind, before and after — not just "CI passed".

🚧 **Do not merge until this repo's own required CI has actually run on this PR.** If the token used to open PRs is the default `GITHUB_TOKEN` inside a workflow run, downstream required-check workflows will not trigger on it — use a real PAT or GitHub App token instead.
